facts.text: Titusville earned its name after a 1873 domino game between Colonel Henry T and Capt. Clark Rice, where the winner chose the town's name.
The Historic Pritchard House on South Washington Ave is open for tours by appointment, offering a glimpse into Titusville’s 19th‑century life.
Titusville’s first aviation center opened in 1927 as an emergency mail landing field and later trained auxiliary pilots during World War II.
Today, the former aviation center is the Arthur Dunn Airpark, a popular spot for skydiving and private aviation enthusiasts.
A vintage Hotpoint sign, installed by Sease Electric in the 1950s, still stands prominently on the historic building at 325 South Washington Ave.
Titusville lies in southwestern LaGrange, just 5 miles southeast of Poughkeepsie, placing it near the Hudson River’s western edge.
